arguments.rationale: External aero NACA0012 at Re=1e6, steady incompressible, fully turbulent per brief recommendation. kOmegaSST is the gold standard for airfoil flows — handles adverse pressure gradients and near-wall separation better than k-epsilon. Air at sea-level properties: rho=1.225, nu=1.7894e-5 (Re=1e6 = 14.6*1/1.7894e-5). simpleFoam steady solver.
